sources.locator: Title search: 随机数发生器建议

statement.zh: **标准**：随机数发生器建议（Recommendation for Random Number Generation）。摘要一句话定性：「This Recommendation specifies mechanisms for the generation of random bits using deterministic methods.」并给出机制来源：「The methods provided are based on either hash functions or block cipher algorithms.」即它是确定性随机比特生成器的规范，而非熵源规范。
statement.en: **Standard**: Recommendation for Random Number Generation (随机数发生器建议).The abstract defines it in one sentence: "This Recommendation specifies mechanisms for the generation of random bits using deterministic methods." with the construction basis: "The methods provided are based on either hash functions or block cipher algorithms." This is a deterministic bit-generator specification, not an entropy-source specification.

statement.zh: 要解决的问题是随机数发生机制的范围界定：摘要写「This Recommendation specifies mechanisms for the generation of random bits using deterministic methods.The methods provided are based on either hash functions or block cipher algorithms.」，§1 把责任压在种子上——「The seed used to instantiate the DRBG must contain sufficient entropy to provide an assurance of randomness.」关键词行是「Deterministic random bit generator (DRBG)…」，属检索入口而非论证。
statement.en: The problem is verifiable random-number generators: the abstract states the scope — "This Recommendation specifies mechanisms for the generation of random bits using deterministic methods.The methods provided are based on either hash functions or block cipher algorithms." — and §1 puts the burden on the seed — "The seed used to instantiate the DRBG must contain sufficient entropy to provide an assurance of randomness." The keyword line reads "Deterministic random bit generator (DRBG)" — an index entry, not an argument.

statement.zh: 使用方式是作为被验证模块里的组件：文件对实现方提出的是要求而非引用关系——「A cryptographic module containing a DRBG mechanism shall be validated (see [FIPS 140]).」并且消费 DRBG 的应用或服务方要按文件自己关于熵源与预测阻力的规则提供两者。
statement.en: It is used as a component inside a validated module, and the direction of the citation runs the other way around: the document states a requirement rather than citing one — "A cryptographic module containing a DRBG mechanism shall be validated (see [FIPS 140])." — while the consuming application or service must supply entropy and prediction resistance under the document’s own rules for entropy and prediction resistance.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 限度一是责任分离：本文件只管 DRBG 机制本身，熵源质量与随机数收集在配套文件里，且其参考清单把 SP 800-90B 标为「(Draft)… August 2012」，并把构造级指南另交 SP 800-90C——所以`熵由 90B 解决`在这份文本里只是未定稿。限度二是它不评价具体实现的安全性，验证走 FIPS 140 路径。
statement.en: The first limit is division of responsibility: this document covers the DRBG mechanism only, and its own reference list carries SP 800-90B as "(Draft)… August 2012" while construction guidance is assigned to SP 800-90C — so within this text the entropy source is settled nowhere.The second is that it does not judge a given implementation; validation runs through FIPS 140.

statement.zh:
版本链在标题页与修订附录：原初版是 June 2006，Revision 1 的三个日期证据都写作 June 2015——页眉「…NIST.SP.800-90Ar1 June 2015」、引用行「Spec.Publ.800-90A Rev.1, 109 pages (June 2015)」与附录 E「In June 2015, the following substantive changes were made in Revision 1 of [SP 800-90A]」。修订记录里最重要的一条是删除：「The Dual_EC_DRBG has been removed, and section numbers adjusted accordingly.」并移除了原先含具体常量的附录。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：随机数发生器建议的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。
statement.en: The lineage is on the title page and in the change appendix: the original was June 2006 and three separate lines date Revision 1 to June 2015 — the masthead "…NIST.SP.800-90Ar1 June 2015", the citation "Spec.Publ.
